defaultStyle: 2D match-3 puzzle game piece, glossy jewel-style illustration with a bright highlight on the upper-left and soft inner shadow on the lower-right, transparent background, single object only, centered composition, no text, no UI, no drop shadow, consistent gem shape across matching pieces so they read as one set, 256x256 target size

assets.name: Ruby Gem
assets.description: A faceted red ruby cut in a rounded square shape, deep crimson core transitioning to bright pink highlight on the upper-left, clearly a match-3 piece, reference gem shape for the whole set

assets.name: Sapphire Gem
assets.description: A faceted blue sapphire cut in the same rounded square shape as the ruby, deep royal blue core transitioning to bright cyan highlight on the upper-left, clearly the blue piece of the match-3 set

assets.name: Emerald Gem
assets.description: A faceted green emerald cut in the same rounded square shape as the ruby, rich forest-green core transitioning to bright lime highlight on the upper-left, clearly the green piece of the match-3 set

assets.name: Topaz Gem
assets.description: A faceted yellow topaz cut in the same rounded square shape as the ruby, warm amber core transitioning to pale yellow highlight on the upper-left, clearly the yellow piece of the match-3 set

assets.name: Amethyst Gem
assets.description: A faceted purple amethyst cut in the same rounded square shape as the ruby, deep violet core transitioning to bright lavender highlight on the upper-left, clearly the purple piece of the match-3 set

assets.name: Bomb Gem
assets.description: A dark metallic sphere with a lit orange-yellow fuse on top, subtle glossy highlight on the upper-left, rendered in the same jewel-piece footprint as the gems, clearly a special explosive piece

assets.name: Rainbow Gem
assets.description: A faceted rainbow gem cut in the same rounded square shape as the other gems, iridescent surface cycling through red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet, clearly a wildcard piece

assets.name: Sparkle Effect
assets.description: A bright four-pointed star sparkle burst with a white-hot center, radiating beams of pale yellow light, semi-transparent soft outer glow, clearly a match-success visual effect

assets.name: Clear Burst
assets.description: A small circular energy explosion burst in pale cyan and white, radial shockwave rings, semi-transparent edges, clearly a gem-clearing effect

assets.name: Board Cell
assets.description: A seamlessly tileable square board cell, subtle dark blue-purple gradient with a faint inset border suggesting a grid cell, very low contrast so gems placed on it stand out, NOT transparent, designed to tile edge-to-edge in both directions
